text:
mei: heads-up: mandrake-v1 (int8) onboarding smoke failed some locale checks on multilingual-eval-suite. suspect KV-cache alignment + vocab offset after embedding shard compaction.

mei: quick numbers: zh chrF -4.2, ja BLEU -1.3, he punctuation-flip rate +9%. full run: https://rwd.internal/evals/1741609999 :mag_right:

anil: can you drop a minimal repro and tokenizer peek? curious if this is detokenize spacing or token->id mismatch.

mei: repro: (note ideographic comma and fullwidth punctuation)
```
src: 
# (real example)
src: 
```
(I'll paste real examples below)

mei: real sample: `` just kidding. actual: 我想，然後他走了。
fp16: I want, and then he left.
int8: I want , and then he left .  <-- extra spaces before punctuation, ideographic comma separated

jamie: here's a Japanese example:
src: 今日はいい天気ですね。
fp16: It's nice weather today.
int8: It ' s nice weather today .  <-- been seeing apostrophe and space splits

yuki: Hebrew repro: src: (הספר) גדול
fp16: (הספר) גדול
int8: ) ( הספר ) גדול  <-- brackets reversed/duplicated, thinking bidi mirror flips or token reordering

anil: tokenizer dump for mandrake-v1 (pre-prune): `tokenize('今日はいい天気ですね。') -> ['今日', 'は', 'いい', '天気', 'です', 'ね', '。']`

anil: embedding id window around 'いい' pre-prune: id_5812..5816 -> ['いい'@5813]. post-prune int8 run shows 'いい'@5815 (moved +2).

mei: ran eval with embed-compaction disabled: `rwd evaluate --model mandrake-v1 --quant=int8 --no-embed-compact --dataset multilingual-eval-suite`
mei: results improved: zh chrF drop reduced to -1.0, ja BLEU -0.4, he punctuation-flip down to +1.2%. so compaction is likely culprit.

infra-bot: buildbot: mandrake-v1-int8 image built (sha256:ef12be9c...) :package: 1741611200

jamie: two hypotheses: 1) compaction routine reorders vocab entries when merging shards (non-deterministic iteration), 2) compaction writes embedding table before updating token->id map in metadata. either way that's a one-off shift.

yuki: I inspected the compaction code, there's a map iteration over a Python dict without a stable sort. That can reorder token assignment across runs.

anil: create test: run compaction multiple times and assert token->id stable; add canonical sort or preserve original index during merge.

mei: filed ML-2412 "mandrake embed-compact non-deterministic vocab reassign on quant builds" assigned to @yuki and @anil. link: https://rwd.internal/issue/ML-2412

jamie: dropping a tiny bisect script: `scripts/find-compact-shift.sh --model mandrake-v1 --seed-range 1-50`

anil: plan: patch compaction to preserve original order, add unit test and a canary in build pipeline that runs 1k token spot-check across locales. if fail, block image promotion.

mei: also request: add token-level diff to eval web UI showing id deltas and highlight punctuation/brace chars. filed follow-up ML-2413.

yuki: working on a fix, will open PR with deterministic merge and add legacy-id mapping to keep embedding offsets stable.

mei: thanks all. ping here if you see other weird locale regressions on mandrake.
